pages.text:
Zac the dog is Jan’s pet.
He is a big pup.

Zac can wag and he can
sip.

He can jog up to Jim,
Jan and Gaz at the top.

Zac the dog gets wet for
fun!

He is hot, so he has a
dip.

Zac is a wet dog. He can
zig-zag and run for fun.

Zac and Jan sit in the
hot sun. Zac gets a pat.
Zac has had a lot of fun.
